name: Invoice checker - demo form
description: Demo version of the invoice checker. Starts from a local n8n form where you upload one invoice PDF. Extracts the vendor, invoice number, date, line items, subtotal, tax and total with Gemini, then runs the same rule checks as the batch workflow: duplicate invoice, line amounts vs qty × unit price, subtotal, 6% tax, total, and date. Clean invoices are appended to the "Approved" sheet, flagged ones to "Needs review" with reasons, and every result to "Results". Uses synthetic test invoices only.

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You copy fields from invoice text. You never check, correct or calculate anything.
- vendor: the seller's company name at the top of the invoice. Never the "Bill to" customer.
- invoice_no: exactly as printed after "Invoice No". If there is none, use null.
- date: the invoice date. If printed as YYYY-MM-DD, copy it exactly, even if it looks impossible. If printed in another format, convert it to YYYY-MM-DD. If missing, use null.
- lines: one entry per item row, with description, qty, unit_price and amount as printed.
- subtotal, tax, total: the numbers as printed, without currency symbols.
- If a value is not on the invoice, use null. Never guess or work out a missing value.
